messages:
elena: deploy-bot just kicked off staged rollout v2.4.1 -> canary 2% (EU region). change window until 17:00 UTC. please watch telemetry :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: v2.4.1 -> canary=2% | regions=[eu-west-1] | changelist=CL#4821
jason: saw a small latency wobble in eu-west trace dashboard at t+6m, tail went from 120ms -> 420ms for a few p50 buckets. not widespread but noisy :thinking_face:
miguel: linking the flame graph and infra: https://dash.redwood/trace/CL4821-eu-6m — looks like a redis reconnect spike on a subset of pods
lina: QA running focused prompt set against canary now, will post results in ~10m. running warm prompt suite + edge cases
elena: ok flagging as observation. ops: any autoscaler flaps?
miguel: no autoscaler churn. k8s events show transient OOMKill on 2 pods around the same minute, likely causes the reconnects. logs: ```kubectl -n inference logs pod/inf-canary-a-7f5 --since=10m | tail -n 20
[ERROR] OOMKilled at 2024-08-12T12:06:13Z
[WARN] KV cache eviction schedule triggered
```
jason: OOM on canary pods is concerning. could be memory regression from new quantization path in v2.4.1. Did we pin quantlib version?
elena: we did move to quantlib 0.9.3 in this build. release notes call it out. Lina — are evals showing quality improvements that justify the change?
lina: quality delta looks good on baseline prompts (+2% BLEU-ish), but QA noted higher memory footprint on some sequences. still running long tail prompts now
miguel: mitigation options: (1) pause rollout and pin back to v2.4.0, (2) scale canary pod memory temporarily, (3) drain affected nodes and restart canary pods.
jason: my vote: pause/hold at 2% until we confirm it's not a widespread regression. we can also increase mem on canary slate as a stopgap while infra investigates.
elena: @deploy-bot can you hold further progression? also add note to changelog: 'hold: observed OOM on subset of canary pods'
deploy-bot: action queued: freeze rollout progression. canary remains at 2%. notify: #eng-oncall #eng-releases.
lina: QA update: two failing long-tail prompts reproduced locally when using quantlib 0.9.3 with sequence length > 2048. attaching small repro snippet.
jason: if repro holds, we should pin the runtime config to use quantlib 0.9.2 for now and iterate. pinning is fast and reversible.
miguel: agreed. will prepare a hotfix pin (CL#4822) to bail to 0.9.2 and push to canary after approvals. estimated deploy time ~12m.
elena: good. consensus: hold rollout (2%), prepare pin hotfix, QA to validate hotfix against repro set, ops to monitor memory. If hotfix clears, we resume. If not, rollback to v2.4.0 full. thumbs? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
jason: :+1:
miguel: :+1:
lina: :+1: QA will run smoke after hotfix deploy
elena: noted. tagging this thread for postmortem if hotfix required. I'll update release notes and change window accordingly. thanks all.
